question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Never changing and therefore boring.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Monotonous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Monotonous **means lacking in variety and therefore boring. (विविधता का अभाव और इसलिए उबाऊ)

 
 
• **Example**: *The monotonous hum of the engine during the long drive made the journey seem endless and dull.*
